description_en: Retrieves a list of scheduled tasks
name: ListScheduledTasks

parameters.help_en: The tenant ID that takes effect
parameters.name: tenant_id

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page.

The maximum number of entries per page is 30
parameters.help_zh:
每页返回条目数。

每页返回数量上限30
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The keyword of the rule name for fuzzy match
parameters.help_zh: 规则名称关键词，用于模糊匹配
parameters.name: keyword

parameters.help_en: The ID of the collaboration group (such as cg_101). If specified, a group task is created (the caller must be a valid group member). If left empty, a personal task is created
parameters.help_zh: 所属协作群组 ID（如 cg_101）；传入时创建群空间任务（调用者需为有效群成员），为空创建个人任务
parameters.name: collaboration_group_id

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries to return in this request
parameters.help_zh: 本次请求所返回的最大记录条数
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The pagination token for the next page
parameters.help_zh: 分页标，供分页使用，下一页token
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en:
Filters by visibility. Valid values:
PRIVATE: visible only to the creator and group owner.
COLLABORATIVE: visible to specified collaborators.
PUBLIC: visible to all group members.

If not specified or an empty list is passed, no filtering is applied. This parameter takes effect only in the group dimension (when collaborationGroupId is specified) and is ignored in the personal dimension
parameters.help_zh: 按可见范围多选筛选：PRIVATE(仅创建人与群主可见)/COLLABORATIVE(指定协作成员可见)/PUBLIC(群内全员可见)；不传或空列表表示不筛；仅群维度（传 collaborationGroupId）生效，个人维度忽略
parameters.name: visibilities

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to return only tasks created by the caller. This parameter takes effect only in the group dimension (in the personal dimension, only the caller's own tasks are returned). If not specified, no filtering is applied
parameters.help_zh: 只看自己创建的任务；仅群维度生效（个人维度恒为自己的任务），不传表示不过滤
parameters.name: creator_only

hasMore.description_en:
Indicates whether more data is available. Valid values:
true: More data is available.
false: No more data is available
hasMore.description_zh: 是否有更多数据。true：是 false：否

abnormalReason.description_en: The reason for the exception. This field has a value only when status is abnormal
abnormalReason.description_zh: 异常原因；仅 status=abnormal 时有值

canDelete.description_en: Indicates whether the current caller can delete the task (only the task creator and group owner can do so). Always returns true for personal tasks
canDelete.description_zh: 当前调用者是否可删除（仅任务创建人与群主）；个人任务恒 true

canEdit.description_en: Indicates whether the task can be edited or deleted
canEdit.description_zh: 课程是否可以编辑或删除

canExecute.description_en: Indicates whether the current caller can immediately execute the task (anyone with visibility can operate. Returns false for abnormal tasks). Always returns true for personal tasks
canExecute.description_zh: 当前调用者是否可立即执行（可见即可操作；异常任务 false）；个人任务恒 true

canToggle.description_en: Indicates whether the current caller can start or stop the task (only the task creator and group owner can do so. Returns false for abnormal tasks). Always returns true for personal tasks
canToggle.description_zh: 当前调用者是否可启停（仅任务创建人与群主；异常任务 false）；个人任务恒 true

collaborationGroupId.description_en: The ID of the collaboration group (such as cg_101). If specified, a group task is created (the caller must be a valid group member). If left empty, a personal task is created
collaborationGroupId.description_zh: 所属协作群组 ID（如 cg_101）；传入时创建群空间任务（调用者需为有效群成员），为空创建个人任务

description.description_en: The description of the to-do card type

digitalEmployeeName.description_en: The list of digital employee names

items.description_en: The name of the currently active digital employee. This value is empty if not configured
items.description_zh: 当前生效的数字员工名，未配置时为空

isOpen.description_en: Indicates whether public access is enabled

model.description_en: The execution model tier. If not specified, the value is not updated
model.description_zh: 执行模型档位；不传则不更新

status.description_en: The task status. Running is returned upon submission
status.description_zh: 任务状态：提交即返回 Running

visibility.description_en:
The visibility scope of the group task. Valid values:
PRIVATE: visible only to the creator and group owner.
COLLABORATIVE: visible to specified collaborators.
PUBLIC: visible to all group members.

For group tasks, the default value is PRIVATE if not specified. This field is ignored for personal tasks
visibility.description_zh: 群任务可见范围：PRIVATE(仅创建人与群主可见)/COLLABORATIVE(指定协作成员可见)/PUBLIC(群内全员可见)；群任务不传时默认 PRIVATE，个人任务忽略该字段

visibleMemberUserIds.description_en: The list of collaborators (excluding the task creator and group creator, who are covered by the authentication layer). This field is returned only for group tasks. An empty list is returned for PRIVATE or PUBLIC visibility
visibleMemberUserIds.description_zh: 协作成员名单（不含任务创建人与群创建人，二者由鉴权层覆盖）；仅群任务返回，PRIVATE/PUBLIC 档返回空列表

items.description_en: The user ID of the visible member

maxResults.description_en: The maximum number of entries to return in this request
maxResults.description_zh: 本次请求所返回的最大记录条数

pageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page
